evidence_text: Official Environment Agency persistent WCS 2.0.1 endpoint for LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model Last Return DSM 2m. The Environment Agency service-transition announcement explicitly lists this endpoint and states WCS provides elevation coverages through an open OGC standard. Associated official DSM 2m metadata is EPSG:27700, 2 m resolution and Open Government Licence. This producer records the service evidence only; parcel spatial join, raster sampling/materialization and height-difference calculation remain local OpenCode responsibilities.
